name: Discipline Kids
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of loving instruction and timely correction in raising children, showing that discipline is an expression of love rather than neglect. Proverbs teaches that sparing the rod is harmful to a child, while proper chastening guides them away from foolishness and destruction. Training a child in the right way ensures they will remain steadfast in that path throughout life, underscoring the necessity of consistent and loving discipline.
